theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_odc_fr_cone_mass
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → μ ((fun x => lam • x) '' W) = ENNReal.ofReal lam * μ W) → μ (ball (0 : Euclid P) 1) ≠ ∞ → ∀ σ : Euclid P, ‖σ‖ = 1 → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < 1 → ENNReal.ofReal ρ ≤ μ (ball σ ρ) → 1 ≤ 2 * μ ((⋃ (t : ℝ) (_ : 0 < t), ball (t • σ) (t * ρ)) ∩ ball 0 1)
